body.x: SEOUL, Korea (AVING) -- <Visual News> 3S Digital expects to unveil 55-inch 120Hz full HD LCD 'XEVA' at the upcoming CES 2008 in Las Vegas, USA. The XEVA series features the company's exclusive image technology 'XEVA' algorithm and is available from 20.1-inch to 55-inch.

Meanwhile, the company will also bring its new TV board, which supports LodgeNet/ ONCOMMNND’ function and ‘Pro:Idiom DRM’ content encryption technology, as well as new set-top box supporting so-called ‘time-machine’ and IP network functions simultaneously.
